Hermit lizard

Overview

The Hermit Lizard wants a secure new home near the lake in the Remote Mountains. He asks Kir to restore the Shell to its pedestal so the lizards will be appeased. In return he provides directions toward the Great Magician; the route is no longer simply the one followed in Zak’s earlier journey. [1, 2]

The Shell and the war with the settlers

Urk-Tar explains that humans have driven orcs out of the Foothills and are advancing into the Middle Mountains. Kir removes the Shell whose presence restrains the lizards, initially refusing to fight humans himself. When Tynachey describes the killing of the tribe’s inhabitants, Kel argues for helping their hosts recover the settlement, and Kir agrees. The Hermit Lizard then offers news of the former Chosen in exchange for placing the Shell by the Remote Mountains’ lake. Restoring it also frees hunters held by lizards. The Hermit directs Kir toward the Great Magician by a route different from Zak’s old tunnel approach. [3, 4, 1, 5, 6, 2]
